description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing a list of nodes in an application. It includes models for node information, a response for node list requests, and a singleton store class that periodically fetches and updates the list of nodes, handling errors and connection statuses.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and periodically updating a list of nodes, including handling network requests, errors, and state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic refresh loop for fetching node data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous request to fetch the current list of nodes from the server.
